description_en: Queries raw alert records within a specified time range for a given rule by paging, including attacker and victim information and traffic address details
description_zh: 分页查询指定规则在时间范围内的原始告警及攻击双方、流量地址信息
name: DescribeAlertLogs

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. Use this parameter together with ToTime
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳。与 ToTime 一起使用
parameters.name: from_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. The value must not be earlier than FromTime
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳。不得早于 FromTime
parameters.name: to_time

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页记录数，默认 10，最多 100 条
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The alert rule ID. You can obtain this value from alert query results or by calling DescribeAlertRuleBaseMeta
parameters.help_zh: 告警规则 ID。可从告警查询结果或 DescribeAlertRuleBaseMeta 获取
parameters.name: alert_rule_id

parameters.help_en: The list of attack results. Valid values: 1: attack attempt. 2: successful attack. 3: compromised
parameters.help_zh: 攻击结果列表。1 表示攻击尝试，2 表示攻击成功，3 表示失陷
parameters.name: attack_result

parameters.help_en: The list of attacker IP addresses
parameters.help_zh: 攻击者 IP 地址列表
parameters.name: offender_ip

parameters.help_en: The list of victim IP addresses
parameters.help_zh: 受害者 IP 地址列表
parameters.name: victim_ip

parameters.help_en: The network type of the alert traffic. Valid values: 0: public network. 1: private network. If you do not specify this parameter, no network type filter is applied
parameters.help_zh: 告警流量的网络类型。0 表示公网，1 表示私网。作为外层筛选参数时，不传表示不限制网络类型
parameters.name: net_type

parameters.help_en: The VPC instance ID of the attacker
parameters.help_zh: 攻击者所在的 VPC 实例 ID
parameters.name: offender_vpc_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The VPC instance ID of the victim
parameters.help_zh: 受害者所在的 VPC 实例 ID
parameters.name: victim_vpc_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The traffic decryption detection flag. Valid values: 0: not decrypted. 1: decrypted. If you do not specify this parameter, no filter is applied
parameters.help_zh: 流量解密检测标记。0 表示未解密，1 表示已解密。作为筛选参数时，不传表示不限制
parameters.name: flow_decrypted

Data.description_en: The query result or operation return data
Data.description_zh: 查询结果或操作返回数据

List.description_en: The list of results on the current page

items.description_en: A single query result on the current page
items.description_zh: 当前页中的一条查询结果

AlertLogTime.description_en: The time when the alert occurred. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
AlertLogTime.description_zh: 告警发生时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳

AlertLogUUid.description_en: The raw alert ID, which can be used to query the alert payload
AlertLogUUid.description_zh: 原始告警 ID，可用于查询告警负载

AttackResult.description_en: The attack result. Valid values: 1: attack attempt. 2: successful attack. 3: compromised
AttackResult.description_zh: 攻击结果。1 表示攻击尝试，2 表示攻击成功，3 表示失陷

CsIp.description_en: The private IP address associated with the alert record
CsIp.description_zh: 告警记录关联的私网 IP 地址

DstIp.description_en: The destination IP address in the raw traffic. This value is not necessarily the same as the victim IP address
DstIp.description_zh: 原始流量中的目的 IP 地址，不一定等于受害者 IP

DstPort.description_en: The destination port in the raw traffic
DstPort.description_zh: 原始流量中的目的端口

FlowDecrypted.description_en: The decryption status of the traffic associated with this alert. Valid values: 0: not decrypted. 1: decrypted
FlowDecrypted.description_zh: 该条告警关联流量的解密状态。0 表示未解密，1 表示已解密

NetType.description_en: The network type of the traffic for this alert or aggregated record. Valid values: 0: public network. 1: private network
NetType.description_zh: 该条告警或聚合记录的流量网络类型。0 表示公网，1 表示私网

OffenderVpcInstanceId.description_en: The VPC instance ID of the attacker
OffenderVpcInstanceId.description_zh: 攻击者所在的 VPC 实例 ID

RefAlertResource.description_en: The detection resource information associated with the alert
RefAlertResource.description_zh: 告警关联的检测资源信息

RefAlertResourceType.description_en: The type of the detection resource associated with the alert
RefAlertResourceType.description_zh: 告警关联的检测资源类型

RefAlertResourceUuid.description_en: The ID of the detection resource associated with the alert
RefAlertResourceUuid.description_zh: 告警关联的检测资源 ID

SrcIp.description_en: The source IP address in the raw traffic. This value is not necessarily the same as the attacker IP address
SrcIp.description_zh: 原始流量中的源 IP 地址，不一定等于攻击者 IP

SrcPort.description_en: The source port in the raw traffic

VictimVpcInstanceId.description_en: The VPC instance ID of the victim
VictimVpcInstanceId.description_zh: 受害者所在的 VPC 实例 ID

Page.description_en: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1

PageSize.description_en: The number of records per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
PageSize.description_zh: 每页记录数，默认 10，最多 100 条

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of records that match the query conditions
TotalCount.description_zh: 符合查询条件的记录总数

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned when the request fails

Message.description_en: The description of the request result or the failure reason
Message.description_zh: 请求结果说明或失败原因

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used for troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于排查请求问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:
true: Successful.
false: Failed
Success.description_zh: 请求是否成功。true 表示成功，false 表示失败
